title: trisetum nanum
intro: Trisetum nanum, commonly known as Dwarf Brome, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Trisetum nanum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
